messages:
anita: Short follow-up from Meridian postmortem. Summary: VPC peering flapped, then on-prem kv invalidation allowed tenant to hit default route. I made a tiny action tracker and proposed owners below.
incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/meridian-2026 1 tracker: MER-3301
matt: I can take peering reconciler fix. Plan: make reconcile idempotent + add route overlap guard. ETA PR + staging by Thu. CHG-4555.
zhao: I'll own the kv invalidation patch. Repro on onprem-harness with 10k clients; root cause looks like interleaved writes during shard rebalance. Estimate 48-72h incl tests.
claire: I'll handle customer comms and the temporary mitigation (edge rate-limiter for tenant). Will coordinate maintenance windows with customer ops. Ticket CUST-11200.
anita: Owners: peering -> @matt (CHG-4555/MER-3301), kv fix -> @zhao (MER-3301/PR pending), comms -> @claire (CUST-11200). Please add dates and blockers by EOD.
matt: Note: customer's peering window is Tue/Thu 00:00-04:00 UTC. Scheduling Thu 01:00 UTC, rollback plan ready.
zhao: Starting debug run now; will open PR when tests pass: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1310
claire: Draft notice ready, holding for CHG slot. Also adding post-change validation call.
anita: Adding monitoring alerts for "tenant_route_fallthrough" > 3/min and kv_apply_error spikes. Will add to MER-3301.
incident-bot: Created follow-ups MER-3301, CHG-4555, CUST-11200 1 https://tracker.redwood.com/MER-3301
anita: Thanks all. I'll kick off a biweekly trends sync in two weeks; ping me for anything urgent. :thumbsup:
